source.bitDepthMeaning: container/subtype precision; not effective converter resolution

analysisMethod.spectralChannelCombination: mean channel power, not summed waveform
analysisMethod.spectrumScaling: one-sided PSD, signal squared per Hz; per-frame DC removed
analysisMethod.pulseMethod: positive spectral flux autocorrelation, 60–200 BPM search; grid phase maximizes flux
analysisMethod.pulseLimitations: Experimental periodicity estimate; not validated beat tracking. Half/double tempo and phase ambiguity possible; no meter or musical certainty claimed.

uncertainty.reason: No capture calibration; FFT/window and normalization affect estimates.

mapping.meaning: Artistic mapping of measured audio features. No playback, audio samples, lyrics, or emotion inference. Timeline sampled from analysis; not every audio sample.
